summary: Underneath it, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you reach, grow, and lift the room and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. At the edge, you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
